caption: What still works when a part fails

rows.what: Every page shows its text, its tables, the menu and the help. Only the live table on the page Data stays empty, and it says so.
The page is plain HTML in a sound order: the skip link, the menu, the content, the help.

rows.when: A typeface file does not load
rows.what: The text is shown in a typeface of the system. No text waits for a file.
The data script refuses it and shows an error in words.
The menu becomes a button, and the page becomes one column.
The menu and the help are left out.
